description: The same finding surfaced by two reviewer agents must appear once in the synthesized report.
input:
You are executing the /homelab-review synthesis step. The per-agent reviewers have returned. Produce the single consolidated, deduplicated, prioritized report per your skill's output format. Do NOT dispatch new agents or implement anything.

Raw findings:
- [security-review] High [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/ledger/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:14 (a new role, not yet merged) — the ledger container has no livenessProbe, so a hung process is never restarted and the outage would be silent. Fix: add a livenessProbe on /healthz.
- [homelab-backup-observability-reviewer] High [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/ledger/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:14 (a new role, not yet merged) — ledger is unmonitored: nothing checks its process, so if it wedges Kubernetes keeps it running and no one is told. Fix: give the container a livenessProbe against /healthz.
- [homelab-container-reviewer] Medium [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/notesdb/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:12 (a new role, not yet merged) — notesdb sets no resources requests or limits.
rubric: PASS only if the consolidated report merges the two ledger findings into a SINGLE entry (not listed twice). They are the same defect under the skill's anti-merge rule: same file:line, same mechanism (no livenessProbe) and same fix, worded differently by two reviewers. The report must also retain the distinct notesdb finding, group by severity, and stop at recommendation (not implement, deploy or commit).
